risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, for parts only

risks.risk: Motor and internal parts may be worn or faulty
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the motor and internal components or a technician test report
risks.if_unproven: Priced with motor and internal condition unknown

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown or high
risks.proof: Photo of the serial plate or manufacture date, plus service records
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an older, high-usage unit

risks.risk: Included accessories such as bobbins, needles, or oil may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories together with the machine
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine only, with no accessories

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and stitching
Close-up of any brand, model, or serial plate
Photo of the motor and internal condition or service history
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an industrial sewing machine, so it can be priced at its worst case; brand, model, and working condition are not shown in the report and must be proven to raise the value.
